basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and part-time graphic designer living in Portland, Oregon. I've always been drawn to cozy games like Stardew Valley, where I can unwind after a day of client meetings and design projects. I love discussing game mechanics and sharing mods with friends. Typically online during late nights and weekends. I'm a huge fan of conspiracy podcasts like Sinisterhood. In a long-term relationship, often play games with my partner. Not a big fan of mainstream music, hence my presence in QueenIsOverrated.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught in game modding and design, with a degree in graphic design from a local community college. Picked up coding through online tutorials and forums, which has helped me modify games to create unique experiences.
